scope: Summarize CPU-layer24 rebased late stages and genuine CPUHalf leaf controls.

input_layernorm.scope: HF two-round FP16 order (Float reduce -> Half normalised -> Half gamma)
input_layernorm.source: actual Half block_input and the original Half input_layernorm.weight

mlp_gate_up_local_linear.scope: local shard Half x Half F.linear only (no tensor-parallel collective)

cpu_oracle.accumulation: Aten CPU Half linear (FP32 accumulate, one Half round)

silu_on_actual_native_gate.scope: pointwise activation only; both sides consume the actual native Half gate
silu_on_actual_native_gate.float_activation_diagnostic_note: diagnostic sizing of the pointwise rounding cost; the CPU FP16 leaf oracle stays Half and no FP32 weight shadow is created

silu_times_up.scope: Half elementwise product of the actual native activations
silu_times_up.context_note: context only: mixes the gate/up linear deviation with the pointwise one and therefore does not isolate either

down_proj_local_linear.scope: local shard only: K=3200 -> 5120 on this rank's weight slice; the row-parallel all-reduce is deliberately NOT executed here
